sources.title: Management Analysts — Occupational Outlook Handbook
facts: Self-employed analysts are typically paid by hour or project
sources.use: Career-income context only; not a forecast of fractional consulting income.

sources.title: Plan your business — Market research and competitive analysis
facts: Market research can assess demand, market size, location, saturation and pricing
Direct research methods include surveys, questionnaires, focus groups and in-depth interviews

sources.title: Business Mentoring, Resources & Support
facts: SCORE mentors advise on planning, sales/marketing, operations, technology and starting/growing businesses
Mentors are volunteers with business experience
